fullSuiteAttempt.finding: The case exceeded its execution allowance while XCTest repeatedly waited for the app animation notification. A two-second sample of the app main thread during a wait showed the normal system run loop waiting for a message. XCTest relaunched and continued with the saved-offer case. The sample cannot identify the cause of the missed notifications.

Review did not schedule, explicit confirmation showed the denied-schedule state, and turning the reminder off and cancelling preserved the deferral. The earlier timeout remains part of the full suite result.
